# AAPI

> OpenAI-compatible multi-model API gateway. One API key. Official list prices. Public docs and examples only.

- Site: https://aapi.ai
- Pricing (human): https://aapi.ai/pricing
- Pricing (JSON): https://aapi.ai/api/pricing
- Base URL: https://aapi.ai/v1
- Chat Completions: POST https://aapi.ai/v1/chat/completions
- Key env: AAPI_API_KEY
- OpenAI SDK env: OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://aapi.ai/v1 and OPENAI_API_KEY set to the same AAPI key
- Docs repo: https://github.com/cozcc/aapi

Model id is `data[].model_name` from the pricing JSON. Copy prices from the official URLs only. Do not invent admin APIs. Send documented OpenAI-compatible chat completions with a user API key.
